name: Abdal-Latif Mirza
role: Amir of the Timurid Empire from 1449 to 1450
contribution: The great-grandson of Central Asian emperor Timur.

checks.lead: Abdal-Latif Mirza (c. 1420 – 9 May 1450) was the great-grandson of Central Asian emperor Timur. He was the third son of Ulugh Beg, Timurid ruler of Transoxiana (modern Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and parts of Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan) and Roqya Katun Arolat.
